Your prompt is now a full-width band in the theme's accent tint, so it no longer looks like an inline code chip.

- With an Omarchy theme that has an `accent` color, your prompt was a pale blue pill, and since 0.80.1 inline code is a gray chip with blue text; the two read as the same kind of thing. Your prompt is now a band across the width with an accent bar at its left edge. Several lines form one block with a continuous bar, which also makes the start of each turn easy to find when scrolling back
- A theme with no `accent`, and 256-color terminals (inside tmux), keep the gray bubble as before. The `bubbleSide` setting still places that bubble, thumbnails and paste chips; the band always spans the width
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.80.2 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
